title: Playing Football on Sundays
sentences: I play football with my friends every Sunday morning.
We meet in the park behind the school.
There are usually about ten of us.
We are not very good, but we enjoy the game.
Last Sunday it rained and the ground was wet.
I fell twice and my clothes were covered in mud.
After the game we drink tea and talk for an hour.
My knee hurt for two days afterwards.
My wife says I am too old for football now.
I think I will play for a few more years.
